prompt: Create a single 2-by-2 transparent character turnaround sprite sheet for a painted quarter-view dungeon crawler. Top-right: NW, facing diagonally up-left away from the viewer, showing back and the guardian's left side. Bottom-left: SE, facing diagonally down-right toward the viewer, showing chest and the guardian's right side. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no stone platform, cast shadow, ground, text, markers, dividers, decorative boxes, extra characters or scenery.
